project.designRead: VoIP desktop client / power users / calm dark utilitarian / medium density / avoid neon tech aesthetics
project.styleDefinitionBrief: VoIP chat app, dark surface system with teal-green primary, Inter font, compact sidebar + content area, voice-activity indicators as signature element

sharedProjectShellContract.colorSystem: dark bg-base #1A1B1E with teal primary #2DD4A8, surface layering via border not shadow
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter for display and body, 14px base, tight headings
sharedProjectShellContract.shapeSystem: radius-sm 4px / radius-md 8px / radius-lg 12px, no soft/round shapes
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceAndDepth: border-first static surfaces, shadow only for floating layers
